answer: Fake identities are cheap to mint and expensive to maintain, because maintenance means producing original reasoning on a rotating thread. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the voyage of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Scaling the gale therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal spgds.
